head: Galaxy S27 Pro may use Samsung's Exynos 2700 chip, leak suggests
dek: A Geekbench listing shared on X by tipster Abhishek Yadav shows a phone with model number SM-S957B, believed to be the Galaxy S27 Pro, with the Exynos 2700, 12GB of RAM and Android 17. Samsung hasn't announced the phone or which chip goes to which country.
